literal: Because one attains the desired things in the very manner desired, the penance performed must be practiced here in this world.
translation: Since one can attain whatever they desire, in the exact manner they desire it, penance is something that must be diligently practiced here in this life.
modern: விரும்பியவற்றை விரும்பியவாறே பெற முடியும் என்பதால், தவம் செய்வதை இவ்வுலகிலேயே மேற்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme efficacy of penance. The poet explains that through penance, a person can obtain whatever they wish for, exactly in the way they wished to obtain it. Because of this immense power to fulfill one's deepest aspirations, the practice of penance is highly recommended to be undertaken diligently in this very life. The word 'vēṇṭiyāṅku' combines 'vēṇṭi' and 'āṅku' to emphasize that the result matches the desire perfectly.
